scope: Real sealed input catalog, COW source snapshot, actual baseline/candidate Hamiltonian and output storage on local Shanghai EVM. Native16 outside-only gas fixture is not a full protein measurement or target fee.

preparation.eligibility: All box lengths, consumed atom positions, interpolated charges and both endpoint sigma/epsilon magnitudes <=2^256, accumulated during existing atom work. Any unsafe input disables shortcut for the whole evaluation.
preparation.policy: Original FloatMath/ABDK binary128. No Fixed96 substitution. Pair order and exceptions unchanged.
